top_signals.title: Gulf Bourses Drop As Iran-US Diplomacy Comes to a Halt
top_signals.summary: Most Gulf equities closed down on Wednesday, after Iran said there would be no talks with the US to end their conflict unless its demands are met.Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi in an article published in the Financial Times on Wednesday said…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Urals Prices Fall to Lowest in Six Weeks at Russian Ports
top_signals.summary: Urals crude prices at Russia's Baltic and Black Sea ports fell to their lowest levels in one and a half months this week, according to Reuters monitoring and LSEG data, as the dated Brent benchmark also weakened and freight costs stayed high.Free-on-board prices for Urals crude for loading at Primor
